powers: You may bury a card to add 1d10 to your Strength or Constitution check, or to your check to defeat a barrier that has the Lock, Obstacle, or Trap trait. (☐ Then you may draw a card.) If it is your exploration, but it is not the first exploration of your turn, add an additional 1d6.
